_comment: POS and KDS ship as a SYNCHRONIZED PAIR: identical versionName and
versionCode, always built from one source commit. build_official_pair.ps1
reads nextOfficialRelease and refuses to build anything else.
expectedCertificateSha256 is the PUBLIC fingerprint of the production
signing certificate. It is intentionally committed: it is not a secret, and
pinning it here is what lets a build prove it was signed by the real key
rather than by the Android debug key or an unknown replacement.
Format: colon-separated UPPERCASE hex, exactly as keytool prints it.
check_signing_identity.ps1 compares this value directly against keytool;
verify_official_apk.ps1 strips the colons and lowercases before comparing
against apksigner. Do not change the representation.
NOTE: this is the CERTIFICATE fingerprint. It is a different value from the
SHA-256 of the keystore FILE. Keystore-file hashes, key paths, backup
locations and passwords are deliberately NOT recorded here.
Artifact SHA-256 values below are of the released APK files and are safe to
publish - they are what a reviewer checks an artifact against.
signingCertificateSubject: CN=RestoFlow Android Production, OU=Mobile Release, O=RestoFlow, C=IL

currentOfficialRelease.status: built / Production-signed / POS installed (update-in-place over v25) on SALEH-POS-TEST-01 / KDS not installed / not uploaded / not distributed
notes: Built pre-merge from release-branch HEAD e62cc54 (application source
2b05204f = the PR #200 Offline Operations merge + ledger/docs only);
PR #201 merged that ledger branch into main at bd3b75d, making the
candidate the official v26. First official pair containing Offline
Operations.
POS v26 was transferred to the personal test tablet SALEH-POS-TEST-01
and installed 2026-08-07 as an UPDATE-IN-PLACE over official v25 -
the first production-certificate in-place update (same package id,
same production certificate, versionCode 26 > 25). Android offered
the Update flow; package/signing compatibility succeeded.
Preserved through the update, verified on-device: the existing device
pairing (station record 'SALEHPOS ONEPLUS'), the restaurant
خرائط البرجر, the branch كفرمندا, employee access, the local
printer configuration, and the shift state. The initial Online launch
succeeded and synchronization returned healthy (all-synced).
Offline validation PASSED on v26: true cold-start Offline boot, cached
menu and modifiers browsable/usable Offline, the Offline banner
appeared correctly, an unpaid Offline order was saved locally, and
local kitchen printing worked.
THREE DEFECTS were discovered on v26 during that physical validation:
(1) after connectivity returned, remote assets (menu images) recovered
but the Offline state stayed latched until a full app restart;
(2) the Offline-created order remained payment-blocked after reconnect
because server acceptance/reconciliation was not represented in the
payment gate; (3) the unpaid customer pre-bill could not be printed
Offline even though kitchen printing worked.
All three were fixed client-side by PR #202, merged into main at
b670b59a92ae7d7e5237a77e751ff84d34fabf2a - the v27 application source.
v26 did NOT pass the final Offline reconnect/payment/pre-bill
acceptance matrix; do not cite it as having done so. It is not a
failed release: it proved the foundational Offline architecture
(cold boot, cached cashier, local order capture, kitchen printing)
works on real hardware, and exposed the acceptance defects that v27
fixes.
KDS v26 was built and verified but NOT installed on any device.
The operational restaurant tablet was NOT touched.
Not uploaded, not distributed, no GitHub Release; artifact files stay
local and git-ignored - only their public SHA-256 values are recorded.

nextOfficialRelease.intendedSource: main at b670b59a92ae7d7e5237a77e751ff84d34fabf2a (application source; the release branch may add ledger/documentation commits only)
notes: v27 is the FIRST Android release containing the PR #202 fixes for the
three defects the v26 physical validation discovered (PR #202 merged
into main at b670b59a92ae7d7e5237a77e751ff84d34fabf2a):
automatic Online recovery - the Offline state now heals itself on real
server evidence without an app restart; an Offline-created order
remains unpayable only until server reconciliation and then becomes
normally payable Online with an honest 'awaiting sync' message in the
meantime; and the unpaid/preliminary customer bill
(حساب مبدئي - غير مدفوع) prints Offline from durable local order
state with a clearly non-authoritative local reference.
Offline payment itself remains UNSUPPORTED by design.
POS and KDS ship as the synchronized pair 0.0.27/27 per versionSymmetry.
versionCode must increase monotonically: 27 is strictly greater than
every code ever used on com.restoflow.pos (v21, vc23, vc24, v25, v26),
so v27 is statically update-compatible over the installed official v26
(same package id, same production certificate, ascending versionCode).
Android refuses to install an APK whose versionCode is lower than the
installed one.

reason: v22 was reserved here while the POS runtime-recovery work was
validated through the POS-only transitional lane. That lane
versionCode 23 (vc23, Debug/JIT, debug certificate, source a243fd6)
and versionCode 24 (vc24, Release/AOT, debug certificate, source
f89c8c4, field test passed on SALEH-POS-TEST-01) on the SAME package
id com.restoflow.pos. Any official build numbered below 25 would sit
beneath already-installed transitional codes, so 22 was skipped
without ever being built. No artifact named v22 exists anywhere.

versionSymmetry.rule: POS and KDS must report the same versionName and versionCode, from the same source SHA, in every official release.
